CREATE TABLE "public"."ActivityLog" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entityId" text NOT NULL,
  "entityType" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "taskId" text,
  "userId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Attachment" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamp(3),
  "fileName" text NOT NULL,
  "fileUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "publicId" text,
  "taskId" text NOT NULL,
  "uploadedById" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Comment" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "taskId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Payment" (
  "amount" numeric(65,30) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'BDT' NOT NULL,
  "gateway" text NOT NULL,
  "gatewayPaymentId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "payerId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" "PaymentStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"PaymentStatus" NOT NULL,
  "transactionId" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Project" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamp(3),
  "description" text,
  "endDate" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamp(3),
  "status" "ProjectStatus" DEFAULT 'PLANNING'::"ProjectStatus" NOT NULL,
  "teamId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Sprint" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "endDate" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "projectId" text NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamp(3),
  "status" "SprintStatus" DEFAULT 'PLANNED'::"SprintStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Task" (
  "assigneeId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamp(3),
  "description" text,
  "dueDate" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "parentTaskId" text,
  "priority" "TaskPriority" DEFAULT 'MEDIUM'::"TaskPriority" NOT NULL,
  "projectId" text NOT NULL,
  "sprintId" text,
  "status" "TaskStatus" DEFAULT 'TODO'::"TaskStatus" NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Team" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamp(3),
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TeamMember" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "teamId" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
